title: Donald Hornig listed as present at Kecksburg

tellings.quote: And I discovered that I had found a document about the Kexsburg UFO, and Donald Horn was listed as being present.

plain: Kevin Knuth, who appears on the show as a NASA whistleblower, says he found a government summary of the Kecksburg accident, an incident with a reported UFO in Kecksburg, Pennsylvania, in 1965, and that a man named Donald Hornig "was listed as being present." Knuth tells it as his own find and links it to Lily Hornig; if the listing is accurate, it would put a named official figure at the scene of the event.
